dmf_shadowbound.name: Shadowbound
dmf_shadowbound.desc:
Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic grants you the following features. | Shadow Magic. Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the Invisibility spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.  Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spell's (choose when you select this feat) | Grasping Shadow. You learn the Mage Hand spell and can cast it without spell components. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). | Lengthened Strike. When you make a melee attack roll as part of the Attack or Magic action on your turn, you can increase your reach for that attack by 10 feet, as your shadow stretches to aid you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. | Ominous Will. Immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 1 on the d20, your shadow attempts to exert its will. Make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you have the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn, at which point you must roll on the Ominous Will table to determine what you do during that turn.
##### Ominous Will

|1d8|Behavior|
|:---:|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|1|Your shadow tears free and takes the form of a Shadow Demon, which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. It is Hostile to you and your allies and acts immediately before you in Initiative. Until it vanishes, you cast no shadow and have Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It vanishes after it has taken 1d4 turns or when it drops to 0 Hit Points, and your turn ends.|
|2-3|You don't take an action or a Bonus Action, and you use all your movement to move. Roll 1d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; or 4, west.|
|4-6|You don't move or take a Bonus Action, and you take the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If none are within reach, you take no action.|
|7-8|You have the Prone condition, and your turn ends.| | Shadow's Favour. Immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 20 on the d20, your shadow attempts to exert its will. Immediately roll on the Shadow's Favour table to determine what your shadow does.
##### Shadow's Favour

|1d8|Behavior|
|:---:|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|1-2|Your shadow pulls you through the dark. You immediately teleport up to a distance equal to your Speed to an unoccupied space you can see. This teleportation doesn't count against your movement for the turn.|
|3-4|Your shadow stretches from your limbs. Until the end of your next turn, your reach increases by 10 feet, and your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage.|
|5-7|Your shadow erupts outward in a 15-foot Emanation originating from you. Each creature of your choice in the Emanation must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 3d6 Necrotic damage and has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.|
|8|Your shadow tears free and takes the form of a Shadow Demon, which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. It is Friendly to you and your allies, obeys your commands (no action required), and acts immediately after you in Initiative. It vanishes after it has taken 1d4 turns or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.|
